visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final portable frames after correcting column winding and the shaft-to-capital ring correspondence. Five open passages, twelve main Doric columns, horizontal attic, stepped molding, paired side porticoes/guardhouses and green roofs are legible. The original simplified four-horse quadriga retains its chariot, winged figure and emblem. The two inspected CC0 photographs confirm the exterior from complementary directions; fine sculpture remains generalized.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final shared-material views, including the north-up placement overlay. Correctly outward column surfaces now render consistently with their capitals. Warm smooth mineral sandstone and painted-metal green roofs remain consistent; no temporary blue/yellow lighting from the rally reference is baked into materials. Mapped roof/core alignment and unload assertions pass. The flat fixture validates transforms; source terrain remains in separate portable/context views.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all nineteen final lighting, distance, mode, silhouette and forced-detail views. Each frame identifies the actual current asset/runtime/LOD bytes. Authored skyline and district retain five passages, side porticoes, columns and quadriga silhouette; the reduced district uses coarser column rings and simplified sculpture without changing the main envelope. Street/closeup resolve the fluting and finer original sculptural forms. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures, not Berlin parcels.

geographicReview.notes: Named gate and main polygon 35184890160623 align with both mapped side-colonnade roofs and projecting guardhouse cores/roofs. Main envelope is about 34 by 13 m, with photographed cornice overhangs and a roughly 26 m sculpture crest. Heading 96.5 degrees makes +X north-northwest and +Z east-northeast toward Pariser Platz. Central east passage [0.43,5.3] defines the 39.942 m host datum. Preserved 4225 Terrarium samples span approximately -2.062852..2.257217 m across mapped parts, with foundations extending to -2.5 m. This coarse slope is not a surveyed plaza elevation; local changes in exposed foundation length are documented. Footprint suppression stays off.

fidelityReview.scope: Main gate, paired side colonnades, projecting guardhouses and original simplified quadriga; adjacent city and interiors omitted.
fidelityReview.notes: Fresh comparison of all 33 final renders against two inspected public-domain Qualla originals: DimiTalen CC0 2017 Reichstag-side overview and LeonhardLenz CC0 2022 Pariser Platz front view. They confirm the Doric column/passage rhythm, attic and stepped end relief, side porticoes, green roofs and east-facing four-horse quadriga. Blue/yellow projection colors are temporary light and are excluded from sandstone materials. Crowds obscure lower details; fine sculpture, reins, facade joints and hidden interiors remain simplified. Earlier attribution-licensed images do not support the current approval; no photo is a runtime texture.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four current levels pass strict triangle/material/download budgets and were inspected: 944/3840/15604/20448 triangles, 1/3/3/3 draws. The corrected full-detail columns require a deliberately authored district version to fit 4000 triangles. Actual imported geometry preserves five open passages, six separating piers and the lintel at 43 controls per level. Declared simplification budgets are not an independently measured global mesh distance.

geometryValidation.notes: Raw source/skyline and all four imported Float32 detail meshes pass finite-attribute, nondegeneracy and winding/normal checks. Repaired 408 inconsistent column-capital triangles and inward shaft faces through consistent clockwise ring correspondence. Exact scoped source regeneration, normal import verification, strict LOD/material checks, four schemas, six pack members and repeated 30-tick state hashes pass. Map frame, scene, terrain, cameras and footing depths remain unchanged. No independent Khronos certificate is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior; dimensions follow generalized Protomaps controls and photographic estimates, not a measured architectural survey.

Doric fluting, triglyph rhythm, shallow relief figures, chariot, four horses, wings and eagle/wreath emblem are simplified original geometry. Fine carved figures, reins and facial anatomy are not exact replicas.
Guardhouse cores, projecting porticoes and connecting colonnades are included; interiors, adjacent city blocks and freestanding street furniture are omitted.
Warm smooth shared mineral material represents cut sandstone without false small masonry courses across the carved columns.
Local Qualla references are inspected but not embedded or redistributed. Terrain/contact evidence is coarse host data, not surveyed ground levels.
